name: Samsung Bespoke Cabinet Thermistor Voltage
purpose: Verify NTC thermistor signal at main PCB CN20/CN40/CN60/CN90 — voltage falls as temperature drops.
failureModes: Stuck high (~4.5 V) or low (~0 V) = open/short or harness fault
Out of range vs compartment temp = failed sensor or wrong connector pin
testingTips: RF23BB/RF32CG self-diagnosis CHECK LIST: 4.5 V warm → 1.0 V cold at listed CN20/CN40/CN60/CN90 pin pairs
Run Engineer Mode → Self-diagnosis (mode 3) or 10 s key combo to surface LED blink for failed sensor

name: Samsung Bespoke Evap Fan Feedback Voltage
purpose: Confirm BLDC evaporator/convertible/ice-room fan feedback while fan is commanded on.
failureModes: No 7–12 V feedback with command present = motor, harness, or FG line fault
Intermittent feedback = ice drag, loose connector, or failing fan PCB
testingTips: F-FAN CN20 16–18; Fridge fan CN20 15–17; C-FAN CN40 11–13 (RF23BB) or CN40 13–15 (RF32CG)
Ice room fan RF32CG: CN20 22–24 — fan may stop with door open; allow 1 min after close

name: Samsung Bespoke Inverter IPM DC Supply
purpose: Verify inverter has adequate DC bus for compressor start on Bespoke inverter platforms.
failureModes: Under 13.5 V DC = comp starting failure / IPM fault
Low voltage with good line supply = inverter board or harness
testingTips: Self-diagnosis: check compressor terminal shorts and IPM pin shorts before replacing inverter
Read inverter LED blink pattern after 5-minute lockout per §6-14

name: Samsung Bespoke Freezer Defrost Heater (63 Ω)
purpose: Verify freezer defrost heater resistance — 63 (230) Ω ±7% at power off.
failureModes: 0 Ω = heater short — power off immediately
∞ Ω = open heater or open defrost bimetal / thermal fuse
testingTips: RF23BB: disconnect CN20 harness; measure CN20 pin 6 ↔ pin 8
RF32CG: disconnect CN70 & CN81; measure CN70 pin 5 ↔ CN81 pin 1
Resistance varies with input voltage — 63 Ω nominal at 120 V, 230 Ω at 230 V line

name: Samsung Bespoke Flex/Damper Heater (135 Ω)
purpose: Verify flex-zone damper or ice-room damper heater — 135 Ω ±7%.
failureModes: 0 Ω = heater short
∞ Ω = open heater or open thermal fuse
testingTips: RF23BB Flex-Zone damper: CN40 pin 25 ↔ pin 27 (power off, CN40 disconnected)
RF32CG ice room heater: CN60 pin 21 ↔ pin 23

name: Samsung Bespoke Damper Heater (24 Ω)
purpose: Verify RF32CG damper heater resistance — 24 Ω ±7% at CN40.
failureModes: 0 Ω = heater short
∞ Ω = open heater or open thermal fuse
testingTips: RF32CG: disconnect CN40 harness; measure CN40 pin 25 ↔ pin 27
Do not confuse with RF23BB flex-zone 135 Ω damper heater on same connector family

name: Samsung Bespoke Ice Pipe Heater (72 Ω)
purpose: Verify freezer ice-pipe heater — 72 Ω ±7% (RF23BB cubed / ice bites paths).
failureModes: 0 Ω = heater short
∞ Ω = open heater or open thermal fuse
testingTips: Cubed ice maker: CN20 pin 19 ↔ pin 23
Ice Bites: CN20 pin 21 ↔ pin 23 — power off, CN20 disconnected

name: Samsung Bespoke Ice Pipe Heater (24 Ω)
purpose: Verify RF32CG ice-pipe heater — 24 Ω ±7% at CN20.
failureModes: 0 Ω = heater short
∞ Ω = open heater or open thermal fuse
testingTips: RF32CG cubed ice: disconnect CN20; measure pin 19 ↔ pin 23
RF23BB family uses 72 Ω on same functional path — confirm model before interpreting reading

name: Samsung Bespoke Fridge Ice Duct Heater (63 Ω)
purpose: Verify RF32CG fridge ice-duct heater — 63 (230) Ω ±7% at CN90.
failureModes: 0 Ω = heater short
∞ Ω = open heater or open thermal fuse
testingTips: Disconnect CN90 harness; measure pin 1 ↔ pin 5
Resistance varies with input voltage — same 63/230 Ω family as freezer defrost

name: Samsung Bespoke AutoFill Overflow Sense Voltage
purpose: Verify AutoFill infuser overflow sensor at main PCB CN90.
failureModes: 0–4.5 V = water overflow detected
4.5–5 V = no overflow
testingTips: RF23BB: CN90 pin 11 ↔ pin 13
RF32CG: same CN90 11–13 per self-diagnosis CHECK LIST
